asserted-islanding-state.description: Consumer-asserted islanding-state for the host's own island scope, consulted only while the host has lost or degraded communication with the device that senses that state (its MID / BESS). Advertised in `$format` as `NONE`, `ON_GRID`, `OFF_GRID` (default `NONE`). See "Asserted islanding-state" below.

policy.description: The host's shedding algorithm and its parameters: `{ "algorithm": <id>, "parameters": { … } }`. The parameter object's shape is advertised as a JSON Schema in the property's `$format`. See "Shed policy" below.
